integrity: The proof uses the full primary-text measure model, the source's nontrivial-kernel theorem and zero-set kernel characterization, followed by an explicit contraction and analytic linear-independence argument. No numerical experiment, finite truncation, or external certification is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns one-generator normalized orbits of bounded normal operators. It proves infinite synthesis-kernel dimension but not preservation of the frame property under arbitrary finite or infinite deletions, and it does not cover general nonnormal operators.
title: Infinite excess is forced for normalized normal orbit frames
